buster-provider-v1.activation: Per resolved plan-node attempt before executeRunnerAttempt; durable completion/admission state does not establish CONFIG generation binding.
buster-provider-v1.limits: timeoutMs/cpuMillis/memoryBytes/processes/logBytes/evidenceBytes/evidenceFiles derive resolved node timeout/limits (artifact aliases); cleanupTimeoutMs derives execution.provider.cleanupTimeoutMs; resultBytes=providerResultLimit+execution.reports.maximumAggregateResultBytes+execution.provider.workerResultWrapperBytes. Resolved plan budgets are task data; defaults/ceilings in resolver/registration remain parent Buster/Nova inventory.
buster-provider-v1.claim: run/module/gate/plan/node/execution from resolved plan; attemptId/number from runner; claimId=claim:attemptId, generation1, worker:buster:local; claimedAt=issuedAt; expiry=issuedAt+node.timeoutMs+(3+cleanup+collectEvidence+finalizeResult presence)*cleanupTimeoutMs+execution.provider.claimGraceMs; queue=issuedAt+execution.provider.queueTimeoutMs. Executor separately reserves full-log completion phase; no assertion that producer phase count is universal.
buster-provider-v1.grants: node grant takes precedence over package:registration grant; absence means empty; intersect declared registration capabilities, sorted. Profile adds provider.execute and deduplicates; profileId=hash(sorted capabilities) prefix; contentDigest=registry.snapshotDigest. These derived sets do not grant undeclared capability or configure independent Core policy.
buster-provider-v1.operation: provider package identity from resolved node; cloned ProviderInvocation task values; versioned buster-provider contract/schema IDs and synthetic schema-ID digest; inputs empty because invocation carries inputs.
buster-provider-v1.recovery: Durable attempt execution/observation stores are existing runner mechanisms; C5 config closure absent. No inferred reset or claim renewal.

prism-native-v3.activation: Producer proposes one operation; transaction/advisory lock persists original envelope before requestWorkerResult. Existing request identity returns original envelope even if proposed budgets/profile/timestamps differ.
prism-native-v3.limits: timeout300000, cleanup10000, log1048576, result16777216, evidence134217728, files64 are current Prism code policies, NOT generated protocol invariants; parent owns literal removal. resourceBudgets requested cpuTimeMs/memoryBytes/tasks derive selected control nativeResourcePolicy.
prism-native-v3.claim: pipeline/plan IDs from idempotency key truncated128; node from operation; execution/attempt/claim/cancellation UUIDs; attemptNumber/generation1; worker prism-worker; now claimedAt/issuedAt; expiry/queue now+10min from Prism policy.
prism-native-v3.grants: Static native profile capabilities artifacts.read/write, network.http, secrets.read, telemetry.emit; grantedCapabilities same list. Parent role/grant policy author required, not independent Core settings.
prism-native-v3.operation: engineRequestSchema(operation) determines versioned schema identity/digest; artifact input comes real content-addressed store; operation/inputName task selectors. Engine content identity from image ENV; development digest fallback is explicit parent scope, not operator-config accepted here.
prism-native-v3.recovery: Native operation store returns original durable attempt; prismAttemptResourceLimits compares new requested budgets against startup policy, recovered uses accepted budget; native executor requires process resource limits equal persisted requested budgets and original active claim/queue.
prism-native-v3.phaseProjection: Prism parent timeout=accepted envelope timeout+selected Prism allowance*cleanup, safe timer<=2147483647, acceptedLimits clips original claimRemaining. Actual host base3+storeFullLog1=4. Pin allowance with immutable execution module; not currently attemptSpecDigest. Independent10min claim unchanged; no Buster authority.

prism-agent-v2.activation: claimAgentJob constructs envelope from persisted request plus DB fence/16min deadline and commits state running+attempt_envelope together. Runner executes job.attempt_envelope; fresh agentAttempt only recomputes implementation profile for digest equality.
prism-agent-v2.limits: Six current literals linked AUTH-PRISM-AGENT-LIMIT-timeoutMs/cleanupTimeoutMs/logBytes/resultBytes/evidenceBytes/evidenceFiles; CLI timeout/owner and HTTP/kill policies separate, not resource-budget substitutes.
prism-agent-v2.claim: DB job id, request digest/request and random fence; runnerId is actual boot identity; DB16min expiry=AUTH-PRISM-AGENT-CLAIM-LIFETIME; claim claimedAt from producer now, issuedAt same; expiry and queue DB deadline; claimId/attempt/cancellation=fence, execution=job.id, attemptNumber/generation1.
prism-agent-v2.grants: Launcher profile declares openclaw.agent/artifacts.write. Engine contentDigest hashes five launcher source files. This is local launcher NOT gateway/model or native engine.
prism-agent-v2.operation: Persisted job request/jobId/requestDigest task data; exact launcher contract/schema IDs and synthetic required-fields schema digest; no artifact input/package list.
prism-agent-v2.recovery: Running/expired/uncertain agent jobs become needs_nova, never blindly replayed. V2 measurement capabilities are unavailable local-cli-process-tree and all budgets unrequested. Requested unavailable budgets may pass schema but actual WorkerAttemptExecutor prelaunch rejects WORKER_RESOURCE_MEASUREMENT_UNAVAILABLE; unknown measurement is never zero.

buster-preparation-v3.activation: Ledger persists reservation/envelope before upload/phase; existing nonreleased reservation returns original envelope; operation embeds complete copied preparation settings.
buster-preparation-v3.limits: Four explicit role policy rows CMP-buster-engine-preparation.attemptLogBytes, CMP-buster-engine-preparation.attemptEvidenceBytes, CMP-buster-engine-preparation.attemptEvidenceFiles, CMP-buster-engine-preparation.completionPhaseAllowance; source/definition docs/review/evidence/config-acceptance/components/preparation-cleanup-binding-definition.md. Current1/1/1 quotas dormant; no invariant1; current8 headroom operator, real4 phase minimum and native INT_MAX coupled timer. Existing preparation settings remain sole authors.
buster-preparation-v3.claim: admission32hex and fixed image slot1003/1004; prepare-admissionId used run/plan/execution/attempt, null module/gate; claim-admissionId generation1 worker buster-preparation; expires/queue now+settings.timeoutMs+8*settings.cleanupTimeoutMs. Multiplicative headroom8 requires explicit phase-contract/policy justification.
buster-preparation-v3.grants: Empty profile capabilities/grants/packages/inputs; engine content digest mandatory64hex; measured native-attempt-tree metric capability units fixed contract.
buster-preparation-v3.operation: admissionId/preparationUid/phase are task/generated bindings; settings in operation are an immutable projection of selected owner settings, not second author; phase decoded by native phase validator.
buster-preparation-v3.recovery: Exact original effect/receipt plus fresh cleanup claim and pinned same-module policy generation defined in docs/review/evidence/config-acceptance/components/preparation-cleanup-binding-definition.md; existing runtime lacks generation binding, no C5 PASS.

buster-source-cleanup-v3.activation: Distinct cleanup attempt of persisted original effect/result; new random claim identity does not overwrite original effect.
buster-source-cleanup-v3.limits: Four explicit role policy rows CMP-buster-engine-preparation.attemptLogBytes, CMP-buster-engine-preparation.attemptEvidenceBytes, CMP-buster-engine-preparation.attemptEvidenceFiles, CMP-buster-engine-preparation.completionPhaseAllowance; source/definition docs/review/evidence/config-acceptance/components/preparation-cleanup-binding-definition.md. Current1/1/1 quotas dormant; no invariant1; current8 headroom operator, real4 phase minimum and native INT_MAX coupled timer. Existing preparation settings remain sole authors.
buster-source-cleanup-v3.claim: Fresh random admission/claim per cleanup; original effect ID/result receipt remains exact through nativeSourceCleanupOperation; do not claim this is unchanged original claim.
buster-source-cleanup-v3.grants: Empty inherited preparation capabilities; profile contract changes to kubeclaw.native-source-cleanup@1 and digest recomputed.
buster-source-cleanup-v3.operation: nativeSourceCleanupOperation(original,result,preparationDigest(effects)) binds previous effect, receipt and cleanup header, not task-supplied CONFIG.
buster-source-cleanup-v3.recovery: Exact original effect/receipt plus fresh cleanup claim and pinned same-module policy generation defined in docs/review/evidence/config-acceptance/components/preparation-cleanup-binding-definition.md; existing runtime lacks generation binding, no C5 PASS.
